objective: Proof: with the floor's offshoot points and endless pendant chains added to the candidate complex, round t's junctions are the deck orbits of clusters of t + 1 points, parents the removable points and loose distinctions the boundary points; and, where the complex's core is a tree, the growth is eventually a polynomial whose degree is one less than the largest number of chains in one piece.
status: Proved 2026-11-19 (referee pending): with the floor allowed and the candidate complex extended by pendant points and rays (the endless chains), under (S3), (S4) and every live component infinite, round t's junctions are the deck orbits of clusters of t + 1 points, parents the removable points, loose distinctions the boundary points; for K a tree the growth is eventually a polynomial of degree R - 1, R the largest number of chains in one component; in bare trees chains come from leaves hanging from knots of degree 2.
title: The identification with the floor's chains, and the dimension
